title: Self-audit & auto-repair contract: AGENTS.md policy + harness audit-evidence gate
description: Extends the development workflow policy: agents must self-audit BASE..HEAD across 7 categories (logic/auth/state/replay/concurrency/edge/UI-API), repair self-found defects via regression-first minimal fixes (max 3 rounds, else BLOCKED/NOT_READY with evidence), and record structured audit evidence at .pair-verification/self-audit.json bound to the current diff. Harness validates the evidence schema (coverage, severities, found_by, fix->finding binding, regression paths exist), rejects missing/stale/wrong-diff evidence (VERIFY_AUDIT_REQUIRED/STALE/SCHEMA/PATH), and gates the verdict: unresolved P0/P1, BLOCKED verdict, or FIXED-without-regression -> NOT_READY. Preserves claim binding, invariant/pack selection, tsc/build/full-suite gates. Dev tooling only — no production PAIR authority/runtime change.
